## Election History

### 2018 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy of [St Mary](https://flow.je/elections/st-mary) (1 seat), 16th May 2018.

**Mark Baker was not elected**.

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[David Johnson](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/david-johnson)** |  | 495 | 60.7% |
| 2 | Mark Baker |  | 309 | 37.9% |

816 votes (inc. 12 spoilt papers)

1,351 registered voters

= 60.4% turnout

### 2022 Connétables Election

Election for the role of Connétable of [St Mary](https://flow.je/elections/st-mary) (1 seat), 22nd June 2022.

**Mark Baker withdrew**.

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[David Johnson](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/david-johnson)** |  | 400 | 54.1% |
| 2 | [Mike Fennell](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/mike-fennell) |  | 317 | 42.8% |
| 3 | ~~Mark Baker~~ |  | Withdrew |  |

740 votes (inc. 13 spoilt papers)

1,377 registered voters

= 53.7% turnout
